title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout, default, licensing and control paths are supported, and it explicitly reports Microsoft's conflicting Android and preview documentation. Minor corrections should qualify the separate scheduled-meeting licensing statement and reconcile the licence-check checklist step with the controls table.

claims.claim: Each Teams Rooms device resource account needs a Teams Rooms Pro licence for this capability.
claims.quote: Pre-requisite: Assign a Teams Rooms Pro license to each resource account you have for your Teams Rooms devices

claims.claim: The Rooms Learn page says only the meeting organiser needs a Copilot licence for Facilitator in scheduled meetings.
claims.quote: Only the meeting organizer requires a Copilot license.
claims.fix: Replace the sentence with: 'For scheduled meetings, the Rooms page says only the meeting organiser requires a Copilot licence; the Set up Facilitator page separately says only licensed users can initiate Facilitator and unlicensed users cannot prompt it (https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams).' Both pages are already cited.

claims.claim: The Facilitator in Teams Rooms page names no meter or separate charge for in-person notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person Teams Rooms notes meter consumption separate charge; opened facilitator-teams-rooms, facilitator-teams and rooms-licensing. The Rooms feature page states inclusion with Pro and names no separate meter or charge.

claims.claim: The Teams Rooms licences Learn page states no price for Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro rooms-licensing price; opened rooms-licensing in full and read its licensing search excerpts. That page lists Pro services and purchasing channels but no Pro price; its no-additional-cost statement is about Basic.

claims.claim: Room meeting audio and transcription data are processed into summaries, decisions and action items.
claims.quote: Meeting audio and transcription data are processed to generate AI‑powered meeting notes, including summaries, decisions, and action items.

claims.claim: Learn says in-person notes are saved as a Loop file in the tenant's SharePoint Embedded storage.
claims.quote: Facilitator stores AI-generated notes as a Loop file in SharePoint Embedded storage that belongs to the tenant

claims.claim: Learn says the in-person notes data is treated as meeting transcript data.
claims.quote: The data is treated as meeting transcript data.

claims.claim: Learn lists a general Facilitator limitation that retention labels are not supported for cloud attachments in AI-generated notes.
claims.quote: Facilitator currently has the following limitations: ... Retention labels aren't supported for cloud attachments in AI-generated notes.

claims.claim: Learn says Facilitator AI-generated notes for meetings are not automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery.
claims.quote: Facilitator's AI-generated notes for meetings aren't automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery because it isn't currently supported.

claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly say whether the meeting-specific automatic cloud-attachment collection limitation covers in-person room notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in person meeting notes cloud attachments automatic collection eDiscovery limitation; opened facilitator-teams, facilitator-teams-rooms and purview/ai-teams-facilitator. No passage specifies cloud-attachment collection for the unscheduled Rooms case.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The setting is at Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: No API or command for the Show Take notes button setting is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Facilitator Show Take notes API PowerShell Pro Management; opened facilitator-teams-rooms and read returned Rooms release-note and meeting-policy excerpts. No command or API for this room-home-screen setting was returned.

claims.claim: Meeting transcription is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. ... Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the Global meeting policy.
claims.quote: To allow everyone in your organization to transcribe meetings, events, and group calls, except users with an assigned custom meeting policy, run the following command: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscription $true

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: No admin-centre UI path for the Teams IsLoopEnabled setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center UI; opened loop-components-configuration and read search excerpts. The Teams setting uses SharePoint PowerShell; the Microsoft 365 admin-centre checkbox controls Loop workspaces instead.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled applies tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: Loop components in Teams | IsLoopEnabled (boolean) | This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.where: controls[3].ui; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: No admin-centre UI path for IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center UI; opened loop-components-configuration and read search excerpts. Collaborative meeting notes use SharePoint PowerShell; the UI controls described are for different Loop experiences.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true enables the collaborative meeting-notes setting.
claims.quote: Enable Loop workspaces creation and Loop component creation and integration everywhere ... [Teams-only] Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true, Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true

claims.where: controls[3].scope; controls[3].note; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled applies tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: The SharePoint collaborative meeting-notes property does not apply to Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: Facilitator can be allowed or blocked in Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Allow or Block.
claims.quote: select Teams apps > Manage apps. ... search for Facilitator. ... Select Facilitator from the app list. ... In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Facilitator is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default.

claims.claim: Facilitator is also blocked if all apps are blocked for the organisation.
claims.quote: However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: Learn gives the Pro Management portal setting path without a platform qualification.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Facilitator Show Take notes API PowerShell Pro Management; read facilitator-teams-rooms in full. Step 4 gives the portal route without Windows or Android qualification; the separate FAQ projects Android for a future release.

claims.claim: Learn links the general transcription policy but does not specify which account's policy governs unscheduled in-person notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person Teams Rooms transcription room resource account policy; opened facilitator-teams-rooms and meeting-transcription-captions, and read Rooms release-note excerpts. No passage identifies the policy subject for unscheduled Facilitator room sessions.

claims.claim: The Set up Facilitator page says Loop file generation was discontinued on 31 July 2026.
claims.quote: As part of this change, Loop file generation has been discontinued as of July 31, 2026.

claims.claim: The Set up Facilitator page says live notes remain unaffected by that change.
claims.quote: Facilitator live notes remain unaffected.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, first bullet
claims.claim: The checklist asks readers to confirm licence assignments, but no controls-table row covers licence assignment.
claims.quote: Confirm Teams Rooms Pro licences are assigned to the resource accounts of the Android rooms you want covered. | Controls rows: Take notes button; Meeting transcription; IsLoopEnabled; IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled.
claims.fix: Remove the first Before rollout checklist bullet, 'Confirm Teams Rooms Pro licences are assigned to the resource accounts of the Android rooms you want covered.' Keep the verified licence prerequisite in Cost and licensing and Scope; do not add a control row.
